svg.text: Figure 14 - What ships to a customer
Everything below is version-locked together by one release tag. See docs/09-release-notes.md.
PHY vendor DFI adapter + training script
2. Deliver NHI traffic at clk_core (1 GHz)
3. Provide the PHY and its training script
5. Confirm timing values against their datasheet
6. Own DFT insertion and physical closure
Every placeholder value marked (P) in the architecture spec must be replaced from the customer's JEDEC copy and
vendor datasheet before verification signoff. Doc 08 (compliance matrix) tracks what is claimed and what is not.
